messages:
daria: Small, unofficial flex

— we just crossed 1,000,000,000 tokens served on hosted-api this week. Anyone up for an espresso & cupcake pop at 11:15? :cupcake: :coffee:
mike: WHAAAAT? That's wild. Massive kudos to runtime and infra. Cupcakes please.
yusuf: Incredible. Can we have a tiny plaque for the kitchen that says '1B tokens and counting'? :laughing:
clare: I'll make a quick graphic for the #announcements-internal post. Anyone want their name on the shoutout list?
daria: Put infra, eng-runtime, devex, and onboarding. Also a tiny nod to the beta customers. No customer names in the post.
ops-bot: metrics-bot: total tokens this week: 1,003,214,446; avg-p95 latency 145ms; error rate 0.008% all healthy
lorelei: Quick poll: espresso shots or cold brew? Reply with "espresso" or "coldbrew"
mike: coldbrew (but I take tea)
yusuf: espresso
clare: espresso wins 2-1. Ordering small cupcakes + vegan options.
people-ops: Please remember to keep celebrations small and within posted kitchen hours. Also swag budget approved for 20 sticker packs. DM me names if you want one.
daria: Love the sticker idea. Maybe a sticker: "1B tokens served" and a tiny Redwood rocket?
clare: Mockup uploaded: https://internal.example.com/assets/1b-sticker.png
mike: Also, tiny idea: let's do a 5-second confetti GIF for the teams who joined remotely and post it in #team-photos.
yusuf: I'll record a quick 5s boomerang and upload.
ops-bot: kitchen booked 11:05-11:25. Please keep it short for the next booking.
daria: Draft announce (internal): `Team hit 1B tokens served on hosted-api this week. Huge thanks to runtime, infra, and devex for keeping us blazing. Short in-person celebration at 11:15 in the kitchen.` Approvals?
clare: +1. Perfect and succinct.
people-ops: Approved. Keep external wording to approved comms; do not include internal metrics or customer names.
ops-bot: nightly-backup: snapshot completed at 04:02 UTC backups ok
daria: Drop a clap if you're coming at 11:15.
mike: 44f
yusuf: 44f
clare: 44f
lorelei: I'll livestream the 5s confetti for remote folks.
people-ops: Sticker list open. DM me your mailing address if remote.
daria: Thank you all. Feels good to celebrate these little wins together. See you soon!
